{{Quote|The man was standing next to the bed of Ancathian funge-flowers. Fearing that I might be in danger, I whistled the proper frequency, and the flowers spewed their pollen into a thick cloud around the man. Humans are particularly susceptible to the funge-flower's pollen, and he was momentarily stunned.|[[Spero]]|<ref name="Spero's Flight">{{WEGCite|story=Spero's Flight|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
'''Ancathian funge-flowers''' were a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. They shared their name with the [[Ancathia system/Legends|Ancathia system]].

They communicated by the means of sound frequencies, and at least one of them was related to their reproduction. A being who knew and could mimic the frequency, could trigger some behavior from these flowers, such as spewing pollen.<Ref name="spero">{{WEGCite|story=Spero's Flight|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

[[Human/Legends|Humans]] were particularly susceptible to the funge-flower's pollen and could be stunned when found amidst a cloud of it.<Ref name="spero" />

At least a bed of Ancanthian funge-flowers was found in the [[Alderaan consular gardens]].<Ref name="spero" />
